notes:
REF-BM-02: Only title and description metadata are fetched; description is discarded, and favicon/preview image are not collected.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description is neither displayed nor stored.
REF-BM-04: Title, tags, and note are editable; URL and description are not.
REF-BM-05: No bookmark deletion operation exists.
REF-BM-07: Items expose title and tags, but no description or actual favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no autocomplete for existing tags.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, note, and URL, but not description.
REF-BM-14: Searches containing #tag do not match stored tag names.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including the quote characters.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results use a fixed insertion order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and viewed, but are rendered as escaped plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Archive is reversible, but permanent deletion is unavailable, so the full distinction is not realised.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are not implemented.
